ogDesc: The 6 closest stays to BITEC, with real distances and prices.
intro: BITEC Bang Na is one of Bangkok's biggest exhibition and event venues, right at BTS Bang Na on Sukhumvit–Bang Na-Trat Road, hosting trade shows, expos and concerts all year. When you're attending, most people want a base they can walk to the show from, or reach in a single BTS stop. The thing to know is that the area immediately around BITEC has few hotels — most sit toward Udomsuk, Bearing and the Bang Na sois, a 10–15 minute walk away, and several run a shuttle to the venue door or the BTS station. Below are places we checked are real and bookable, with real distances to BITEC, ordered cheapest to priciest.

blocks.html: Short answer: BITEC itself is only about 160 m from BTS Bang Na, linked by a skywalk, but the area right by the venue is mostly offices and condos rather than hotels. The places you can actually walk to the show from sit in a 10–15 minute radius — Cubic Bangna, Thomson Residence (with a BITEC shuttle), Brighton and Hop Inn — while for a 5-star you just ride the BTS a few stops from On Nut (Avani Sukhumvit). Below are places we checked are real and bookable, with real distances to BITEC, ordered cheapest to priciest.

blocks.text: Hotels near BITEC, by distance & budget

items.name: Hop Inn Bangkok Bangna
items.meta: 📍 12-min walk (1 km) · skywalk near the end to BITEC · ★ 2-star · Best for: Budget · one-night event stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A budget property from the Hop Inn chain in Bang Na — clean, simple rooms to the chain's standard, with free parking, and the cheapest pick in the area. It's about 1 km from BITEC, roughly a 12-minute walk using the footbridge/skywalk near the end (the hotel's own site claims faster, but it's worth allowing a little more time). There's no pool or gym, but for a night or two during an event on a tight budget it's good value.

items.name: Takka Hotel - Bangna
items.meta: 📍 14-min walk (1.1 km) · near BTS Udomsuk to BITEC · ★ 3-star · Best for: Mid-budget · likes being near the BTS · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small hotel near BTS Udomsuk at an easy price, well reviewed for clean rooms and helpful staff, close to a 7-Eleven and restaurants. It's about a 14-minute walk to BITEC, or you can ride the BTS one stop from Udomsuk to Bang Na if you'd rather not walk far. Worth knowing: road-facing rooms can catch traffic and BTS noise, so ask for an inner room for quiet. A good fit for event-goers who want a fair price and easy BTS access.

items.name: Cubic Bangna
items.meta: 📍 9-min walk (700 m) to BITEC · ★ 3-star · Best for: Event-goers · genuinely walk to the venue · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 3-star hotel right on the Sukhumvit–Bang Na corner, about a 9-minute walk to BITEC and close to BTS Bang Na too. Rooms are modern and soundproofed, and reviews call it clean and well kept — a sensible balance of price and walking distance to the show. It suits anyone working a trade show or expo who wants to nip back for a midday rest without a car, with Central Bangna and Mega Bangna nearby for an evening meal.

items.name: Thomson Hotels and Residences Bangna
items.meta: 📍 10-min walk (800 m) · BITEC shuttle to BITEC · ★ 4-star · Best for: Longer stays/teams · suites with kitchen · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A serviced apartment within walking range of BITEC, about 800 m, that runs a scheduled shuttle to the venue plus a shuttle to BTS Bang Na. Units run from studios up to multi-bedroom suites, each with a fridge and kitchen corner, which suits exhibitors staying several days or teams who want more space to keep working in the room. It's next to HomePro Bangna, near Mega Bangna and IKEA, and an easy drive to Suvarnabhumi Airport.

items.name: Brighton Hotel & Residence
items.meta: 📍 12-min walk (950 m) · BITEC shuttle to BITEC · ★ 4-star · Best for: Want a 4-star · indoor pool · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 4-star in the Bang Na business area with spacious rooms from 38 sq m, an indoor pool and a gym. The handy part for event-goers is the free scheduled shuttle to BITEC, with the venue about 950 m away, set near Central Bangna and Mega Bangna. A good pick if you want a nicer room with fuller facilities than the small hotels offer, but aren't ready to pay 5-star rates.

items.name: Avani Sukhumvit Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 4 BTS stops from On Nut (20-min drive / 9 km) to BITEC · ★ 5-star · Best for: Want 5-star · travelling by BTS · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star connected directly to BTS On Nut — ride the Sukhumvit line four stops to Bang Na for BITEC with no line change. Rooms are fresh and spacious with city views, plus a rooftop pool and bar; by car it's about 9 km and 20 minutes. It suits anyone who doesn't need to walk to the venue but wants a proper upscale base in central Sukhumvit, with plenty of dining and malls, then takes the BTS to the show and skips the Bang Na morning traffic.

faq.q: Which hotel is the closest walk to BITEC?
faq.a: The area right in front of BITEC is mostly offices and condos, so few hotels sit at the venue itself. The closest walkable hotel is Cubic Bangna at about 9 minutes (700 m), followed by Thomson Residence at about 800 m and Brighton at about 950 m — and the last two both run a shuttle to the BITEC entrance, so if it's raining or you have heavy bags you can ride instead of walk.

faq.q: How do I get to BITEC by BTS?
faq.a: BITEC is right by BTS Bang Na on the Sukhumvit line, only about 160 m from the station, with a skywalk linking the platform straight into the venue — use Exit 1. If you stay around Udomsuk or Bearing it's a single BTS stop to Bang Na, and from inner Sukhumvit areas like On Nut or Asok it's the same line straight through with no change. During big shows it gets busy, so allow a little extra time to queue for the train.

faq.q: How do I get from Suvarnabhumi Airport to BITEC?
faq.a: The easiest way is a taxi or Grab straight from Suvarnabhumi, about 30–45 minutes depending on traffic, since BITEC is on the east side of the city and not far from the airport. Another option is the S7 bus, which runs from Suvarnabhumi past Central Bangna and BITEC directly for about 35 THB in roughly 50 minutes. If you prefer rail, take the Airport Rail Link into town and change to the BTS Sukhumvit line for Bang Na, though that involves a few transfers — for a group with luggage, a taxi is simpler.
